[[31 ABY]] and [[34 ABY]]The events of ''Star Wars: Han Solo - Hunt for the Falcon'' take place between the theft of the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' by [[Gannis Ducain]], as depicted in "[[Flight of the Falcon, Part 5: Grand Theft Falcon]]," and the events of {{Film|VII}}. The events of "Grand Theft Falcon" take place no earlier than around [[31 ABY]] per the reasoning [[Template:SequelEraContentDate|here]], while ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''The Force Awakens'' to [[34 ABY]]. |series= |preceded by= |followed by= }} '''''Star Wars: Han Solo - Hunt for the Falcon''''' is a [[canon]] [[2025]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries written by [[Rodney Barnes]] and illustrated by [[Ramon Rosanas]]. The [[Han Solo - Hunt for the Falcon 1|first]] of five issues was published by [[Marvel Comics]] on [[September 3]], 2025.
